_doc: Type profile: a resort (one site, many villas or rooms, different guests at once, staff and a front desk). content/units.json lists the units; the guest's own comes from the link (?unit=<id>) or the picker. Its strings replace the engine's home words. sections: as in types/home.json; no garbage (the resort handles it).
notes: The resort's real pin. The official front desk channels the resort publishes (never a staff member's own number). Each unit its own facts, check-in and check-out. A Today notice the resort changes.

en.houseGuideLead: Pools, food, rules and how things work at the resort.
en.outside: You seem far from the resort. Distances from you still work.

en.welcomeSub: Everything for your stay, at the resort and around it.
en.housePhotosSub: Photos, beds and what it has
en.extrasLead: The front desk arranges these for you.
en.arrivalLead: By car or by bus, and getting around once you are here.
en.whatToDoLead: What to do and see around the resort.
en.eventsLead: Fiestas and traditions around the resort.
